newsitem.title: FRANCE: Citroen picks Havas unit for Web site.
newsitem.headline: Citroen picks Havas unit for Web site.

text.p: Connect World, the multimedia unit of Havas' Havas Advertising, said on Tuesday that PSA Peugeot Citroen's Citroen unit had chosen it to create and run its site on the Internet's World Wide Web.
Connect World said in a statement that the site had been launched last March. At the launch it had about 100 pages, but the full 200 pages had only just been finished.
The site carries information on Citroen cars in both French and English which is valid in all parts of the world, the statement said.

Citroen's Web site won one of two prizes for Internet sites awarded by weekly advertising industry magazine Strategies late last month. "The site...managed to combine imagination and a practical sense," the magazine said.
Connect World said it had tried to create something unusual for the Internet, using a black "cyberspace" background to symbolise the universe.
